caption:
Feeling in need tonight? This was Musa's dua

After watering their flocks for them, Musa turned to the shade and told his Lord that he was in need of whatever good He would send down. A short dua for the nights when all you have left is asking.

Surah Al-Qasas 28:24

Say it once before you sleep, and trust Him with what you need

#dua #prophetmusa #duaforrizq #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: So he watered [their flocks] for them, then he turned to the shade and said, “My Lord, I am desperately in need of whatever good You may send down to me.” (Surah Al-Qasas 28:24)
